# Kalatattva — Wedding Photography & Films

> Kalatattva Photography is a wedding photography and cinematography studio run by a talented crew of 7–10 specialists — candid and traditional photographers, cinematographers, drone pilots, lighting hands and editors (450+ weddings captured). Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, the studio specialises in Gujarati and Marathi celebrations: full wedding coverage (pithi, haldi, mehndi, hasta melap, saptapadi, vidai), pre- and post-wedding shoots, shrimant (godh bharai) and baby showers, garba and sangeet nights, intimate home functions and poojas, plus celebrity and grand events at venues from Taj hotels to stadium stages. Regularly serving Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Mumbai, Pune, Nashik, Udaipur and Goa — with travel available anywhere in India.

## Services

- Wedding Photography & Films — full photo & film crew, candid + traditional coverage, cinematic highlight film, drone, same-day edit teaser, premium album
- Pre & Post Wedding Shoots — story-driven couple shoots at heritage, beach and palace locations, styled and colour-graded like film stills
- Shrimant & Baby Showers — godh bharai ceremonies, family portraits and newborn sessions
- Garba, Sangeet & Navratri Nights — low-light, multi-camera coverage of dance floors, stages and stadium-scale garba events
- Home Functions & Poojas — griha pravesh, mundan, engagements at home, satyanarayan katha, with unobtrusive coverage
- Celebrity & Grand Events — large event teams, press-ready delivery and NDA-friendly workflows for five-star and stadium productions

## Booking

Share your wedding date and list of functions via the contact form, WhatsApp or a call. The studio confirms availability, sends a custom quote, and a small advance locks the dates. Delivery: same/next-day social teaser, edited previews within a week, full gallery and films within 4–6 weeks.
